errorCodes.meaning: The maintainer holds no credential under this identifier that this consumer may act on. Deliberately conflates "no such credential" with "not yours" — see Custody scope.
The credential is not in the `active` state, so there is nothing to archive. A consumer SHOULD read the current lifecycle before retrying.
